changelog: Green means someone is actually there, and answers attach to the exact question they answer. Presence dots everywhere now require a recent verified heartbeat, every tip names a command that exists, the client sends zero analytics, and replies can carry an explicit target: pick the message you're answering and the thread shows the quote.
features: vibe_start's card, list, terminal title and badge count only recent verified heartbeats — away and stale rows say so in words, never in green
Rotating tips and guided actions only suggest commands a default session actually registers
The setup_complete analytics event is removed; SECURITY.md's no-telemetry claim is now enforced by test
vibe_reply accepts an explicit reply target (#id shown beside messages); unknown targets are refused with candidates, never guessed; receipts name the new message id and its target
Thread views render the quoted parent (↩ replying to #id) and honestly mark replies to unavailable messages
